items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was very distressed ‘cause I wasn’t able to use him anymore, he just wouldn’t take flute calls and he was my favorite player.

ctx.x: It’s too bad that he stopped.
I was very distressed ‘cause I wasn’t able to use him anymore, he just wouldn’t take flute calls and he was my favorite player.
Yeah, he was a terrific flute player. So also Chet recorded one of your tunes, “Tommyhawk.”
